evidence: The veneer jumps to SRAM getter that reads a halfword from event + 8 and returns its low 15 bits. The return-to-dial callback compares the result to 7 and only enters its selection-and-persistence branch on equality. Page creation stores its root and page destroy clears the root slot. The entry prologue includes UBFX R0,R0,#0,#15, so a 10-byte relocated prologue is necessary.
scope: ui.event.code covers all callers; the settings point covers the specified callback while its page is active
limitations: Changing event code affects downstream branches; the global point affects all calls to the getter. Shared entry publication and rollback still require all affected threads to be quiescent; not device-validated.
